Treasurer Office
Hollie Zurcher
Contact
402-821-2375
402-821-3372 – Fax
hzurcher@salinecountyne.gov
Treasurer Office
Duties:
Collecting all revenues for the County
Billing and collecting all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Registering all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
Issuing driver licenses, C.D.L.’s, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, etc.
Disbursing collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
